metadata.case_name: LI YUET YEE AND OTHERS v. NG CHI HANG

plaintiff.education_level: studied locally up to the secondary level

injuries.description: closed fracture of her right femur
source: Initial assessment revealed a closed fracture of her right femur and an open dislocation of her left knee.

injuries.description: open dislocation of her left knee
source: Initial assessment revealed a closed fracture of her right femur and an open dislocation of her left knee.

injuries.description: closed fracture of her right acetabulum
source: A closed fracture of her right acetabulum was also evidenced on X-ray films.
injuries.icd_description: Fracture of acetabulum without disruption of pelvic ring

injuries.description: slight separation of her right sacro-iliac joint
source: Apart from the acetabular fracture, slight separation of her right sacro-iliac joint and fracture of the tip of the left transverse process of her fifth lumbar vertebra were also seen.
injuries.icd_description: Dislocation of sacroiliac or sacrococcygeal joint without disruption of pelvic ring

injuries.description: fracture of the tip of the left transverse process of her fifth lumbar vertebra
injuries.body_part: left transverse process of fifth lumbar vertebra
source: Apart from the acetabular fracture, slight separation of her right sacro-iliac joint and fracture of the tip of the left transverse process of her fifth lumbar vertebra were also seen.

injuries.description: injury to the anterior cruciate and medical collateral ligaments of her right knee
source: There was also evidence of injury to the anterior cruciate and medical collateral ligaments of her right knee when it was examined under anaesthesia during the operation.
injuries.icd_description: Injury to multiple structures of knee

injuries.description: posterior cruciate ligament injury of her left knee (reconstructed)
source: Repair of the posterior cruciate ligament of her left knee was performed on 11/07/2003.
Because of persistent instability of left knee, reconstruction of her posterior cruciate ligament (PCL) was suggest on 02/06/2005.
She was admitted to Princess Margaret Hospital on 20/07/2006 and received the reconstruction of her PCL on 21/07/2006.

injuries.description: loosening of 1 screw and degeneration of right hip
source: X-ray of pelvis showed loosening of 1 screw and degeneration of right hip.
injuries.icd_description: Other specified injuries to the hip or thigh

manifestations.description: Laxity of the anterior cruciate ligaments of both knees
Muscle power of both her lower limbs were slightly impaired
Walking tolerance was limited and she needed walking aids
Persistent pain over right knee, right hip, left knee and right thigh
Range of movement of left knee was 0°-75° (20.9.2006)
Range of movement of left knee was 0°-90° (19.10.2006)
Positive posterior drawer signs on both knees
X-ray of right hip showed decrease in joint space
Sleep difficulties, intrusion, irritability, avoidant behaviours and hypervigilance
Clinical Impression: PTSD (Caritas Medical Centre report)

treatments_received: debridement and external fixation for her left knee
insertion of Steimann pin to her right tibia for skeletal traction
repair of the posterior cruciate ligament of her left knee performed on 11/07/2003
open reduction and internal fixation of her right acetabular and femoral fractures performed on 15/07/2003
physiotherapy (attended a total of 110 sessions between 13/10/2003 and 31/05/2005 and a further 24 sessions up to 30/05/2007)
transferred to intensive care unit and later orthopaedic ward
transfer to rehabilitation ward in Caritas Medical Centre on 15/09/2003
removal of one loosened screw performed under general anaesthesia on 16/01/2007
psychological/psychiatric treatment including psychoeducation, CBT and medication (antidepressant and sleeping pills)
treatments_future: follow up treatment after joint replacements

losses.description: Reduced function of her hips and knees, instability and persistent pain affecting lower limbs
Limited walking tolerance; needs walking aids and rests every 20-25 minutes; can walk with one crutch
Her body has been left with a number of extensive scars

losses.category: Loss of ability to do domestic tasks
losses.description: She cannot squat or sit on low stool and can only carry objects of less than 5 kg

losses.category: Loss of confidence in going out in the public
losses.description: Avoidant behaviours and hypervigilance reported by psychiatric assessment

comparable_cases.case_name: Ngan Man Yuk suing Ho Chung Keung, her husband and Next Friend and Lau Kwan Him and Another
comparable_cases.injury_description: extent of injury similar except that the Wife did not suffer from cognitive deficits in terms of memory and executive function
